verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only relative performance claims (e.g., '2X faster than H100', '110X faster than CPUs') and memory specs (141GB HBM3e, 4.8TB/s), but no actual TFLOPS/TOPS figures broken out by precision (FP8, FP16, TF32, INT8) or with sparsity on/off as required for engineering sizing calculations.
